chapter: Maynard Ferguson and the drinking life
title: The 200-shot bet at the Beeches
summary: A drinking bet with the Ferguson band about a club he never played, ending in twenty shots on the bandstand.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Oh yeah. One time we were playing with Maynard’s band and, oh that was a drinking band I mean it was just everything. But we were going to play at a place called the Beeches, which you know up there.

Rome. We were coming through this area, and I said I’ve never played the Beeches before. And the guys said, “oh you’ve played here before,” they said, “you were just drunk and you don’t remember it.” I said, “I know I haven’t played this place.” I said, “well I’ll bet you I haven’t.” And they said, “what do you want to bet?” I said, “I’ll bet you 200 shots of liquor that I haven’t played this club” or this place. They said, “you’re on.” So we walked into the place and I’m sitting down and we’re going on in an hour and © Fillius Jazz Archive -23-

I’m having dinner, kind of sitting alone for some reason, I don’t know why, but having some chicken. And when the managers went into office and saw the books for the last time the band had played there, and it was before I had joined the band. So the waitress comes over, this poor waitress, she just looked at me and she’s got 20 shots of liquor on a tray. She says, “I think these are for you.” I said, “oh yeah. Just set them right down here.” But a lot of people don’t realize man, that drinking 20 shots of liquor, there’s a way to — first of all when you drink whiskey you’re also breathing it in [gasps] like that. So I said, “just bring me another order of bread,” and I took the 20 shots and put it in a glass, you know, 20 shots of liquor it didn’t do anything. And I went on the bandstand and after playing “Give it One” and whatever else those lunatic tunes were, by the second set I was totally sober anyway. But I did the 20 shots. And we had been drinking all day anyway, and continued through the night.
